items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: Another powerful cornet player was this fellow, Manuel Paredes.

ctx.x: I always hear Bowling as being a very good cornet player in the sense that he was a powerful cornet player.

He was. Very powerful. Another powerful cornet player was this fellow, Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes guy had an E flat cornet. Oh yeah. That E flat something. That was played in parade. I remember that. I remember some of that. Of course that was a, that was a cornet bigger than that I believe. But it was tough to blow. Anybody could blow one of them.
